name: Pet.uy
description: Online pet shop selling dog and cat food, snacks and cat litter from brands such as Pro Plan, Eukanuba, Pedigree, Hill's and Whiskas, retail and wholesale. Its site states deliveries within the day in Montevideo and within 72 hours to the rest of the country.
description_es: Pet shop en línea con alimento, snacks y arena para perros y gatos de marcas como Pro Plan, Eukanuba, Pedigree, Hill's y Whiskas, minorista y mayorista. Su sitio indica entregas en el día en Montevideo y en menos de 72 horas al resto del país.

ships_to.notes: Same-day delivery in Montevideo and within 72 hours nationwide via Expreso Uruguayo per the store's home page FAQ

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.
